title: Mad Cow Paintball
specs: 40 acres of paintball fields including 7 fields: 4 concept/spools, 2 air-ball, 1 forest field
Family owned farm with over 400 acres, 40 acres dedicated to paintball
Low Impact paintball ages 8 and up
Must complete online waiver before playing; under 18 requires parent/guardian signature

Markers must be 285 fps or less, checked by chrono ref
Groups can play alone with assigned referee or mix with others
Gellyball groups must be 6 or more players and reserved in advance

includes: Marker (paintball gun), face mask, 3000 PSI high pressure air tank, 500 paintballs, free air fills, pod pack if available
All day air fills included in full rental package
blurb: Mad Cow Paintball operates on a family farm near Cedar Creek, Nebraska, with 40 acres set aside for paintball. They offer rental packages including marker, mask, air tank, paintballs, and pod pack for 3 hours of play. They have multiple fields and provide safety briefings and referees for all games.
extraNote: Deposits are non-refundable for no shows; deposit applies to entry fee · Play time limited to 3 hours; extra time can be purchased if available · Open in rain and snow except if lightning is in the area · No alcohol allowed on premises during business hours · No dogs allowed on the field · March through November
